vb_textbox.text: I started with the little gnome and kept choosing it until his numbers got low, then I would switch to choosing the gnome with the tall hat until his numbers started to be lower. Basically, I would switch to the other gnome when it's numbers got lower. I seemed to find more success with the gnome with the tall hat, but I'm not sure whether this would be the same for you.I would recommend that you every so often try to speed up your reaction time just to keep yourself alert (I don't believe you get any extra points for speed).
